content.text: {"conditions":{"rc1":{"status":"gap","note":"The Agency's conclusion that Complainant 'failed to prove that he was subjected to discrimination as alleged' is stated without any reasoning or evidence linking the cited allegations to that finding, and claims (a)-(j) are not set out in the record."},"rc2":{"status":"review","note":"Allegations are attributed to Complainant and some to ROI pages (e.g., 'Report of Investigation at 246-7', 'ROI at 49-51'), but the source of the 'witness' report to the Inspector General is unidentified and allegations (k)-(q) have no individual source citations."},"rc3":{"status":"review","note":"Allegation dates from April 15 to July 10, 2018 are given, but they are listed in reverse order and the dates of the EEO counseling, investigation, hearing request and withdrawal, final decision, and appeal are absent."},"rc4":{"status":"gap","note":"The record does not identify who made the Agency's final decision, what standard was applied beyond a citation to 29 C.F.R. § 1614.110(b), or whether Complainant's responses or mitigating information were considered."},"rc5":{"status":"gap","note":"Because the Agency's reasoning, claims (a)-(j), the ROI evidence, and the decision-makers are missing, an independent reviewer could not assess whether the conclusion is supported without outside context."}},"remediation_note":"The record would need the full list of claims with source citations for each, a dated timeline of the counseling, investigation, hearing withdrawal, final decision and appeal, and the Agency's stated analysis connecting the ROI evidence to its conclusion. It should also name the decision-maker and the criteria applied, and show how Complainant's responses were considered."}
